description: Source code for the 'Quality Inspection' doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, validation, status updates, and related utility functions.

classes.name: QualityInspection
classes.description: Represents a quality inspection document with validation, status updates, and reference management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation and sets item specifications and inspection status.

methods.name: get_item_specification_details
methods.description: Fetches and sets quality inspection readings based on item template.

methods.name: get_quality_inspection_template
methods.description: Retrieves the quality inspection template based on BOM or item code.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Updates quality inspection references upon submission.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Removes quality inspection references upon cancellation.

methods.name: update_qc_reference
methods.description: Updates related records with the current quality inspection reference.

methods.name: inspect_and_set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of each reading based on acceptance criteria.

methods.name: set_status_based_on_acceptance_values
methods.description: Sets reading status based on acceptance values or ranges.

methods.name: min_max_criteria_passed
methods.description: Checks if numeric readings are within min/max range.

methods.name: set_status_based_on_acceptance_formula
methods.description: Sets reading status based on acceptance formula evaluation.

methods.name: get_formula_evaluation_data
methods.description: Prepares data for formula evaluation from readings.

methods.name: item_query
methods.description: Search query for items related to quality inspection.

methods.name: quality_inspection_query
methods.description: Search query for quality inspection records.

methods.name: make_quality_inspection
methods.description: Creates a new Quality Inspection document from a BOM.
